summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Product Model Refactoring for DynSoft Pharma. All backend tests (13/13) passed. All frontend UI tests passed. The refactoring successfully removes price/stock fields from Product model - these are now calculated from stock_lots and price_history tables.

minor.issue: MongoDB _id was not being excluded after insert_one, causing serialization error
minor.fix_applied: Added doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one in routes/products.py

design_issues.issue: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent

backend: GET /api/products returns products with calculated stock, price from stock_lots and price_history
POST /api/products creates product without price/stock fields (only basic info)
PUT /api/products updates product basic info without price/stock
GET /api/products/{id}/lots returns stock lots for a product
Supply validation creates stock_lots entries when validated
Product price comes from price_history table after supply validation
New products have default min_stock of 10
GET /api/products/alerts returns low stock and expiration alerts
Price/stock fields in create request are correctly ignored (model extra='ignore')
frontend: Products page loads correctly with 38 products
Product cards display stock and price (calculated from backend)
Product form does NOT have price field
Product form does NOT have stock field
Product form does NOT have min_stock field
Product form does NOT have expiration_date field
Product form shows info message about prices/stock managed via approvisionnements
Product form has basic fields: name, barcode, reference, category, unit

critical_code_review_comments: Product model refactoring is well-implemented with clear separation of concerns
stock_service.py provides optimized batch queries to avoid N+1 problems
Frontend form correctly shows info message guiding users to use Approvisionnements for stock/price
seed_data_creation: Test products created with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Product model refactoring fully tested and working. Product model now only stores basic info (name, barcode, category, unit, description). Stock is calculated from stock_lots table (sum of current_quantity). Price comes from price_history table (latest entry). min_stock from stock_config table (default 10). Supply validation creates stock_lots entries. Frontend form simplified to only basic fields with info message about approvisionnements.
